flags.why: The agitated, noisy sense is an ordinary colloquial use, not a rare one ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/s%E1%BB%93n_s%E1%BB%93n)).
This is a familiar spelling name used to distinguish S from X, so rare is misleading ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/s%E1%BB%9D_n%E1%BA%B7ng)).

This name is used mainly in northern Vietnam, especially Hải Phòng, and needs a regional label ([Hải Phòng tourism guide](https://cdn.haiphong.gov.vn/gov-hpg/PortalFolders/ImageUploads/SDL/7993/Tiem%20nang%20du%20lich/Checklist%20HP.pdf)).
